text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Th-This is Gio Gehenna... The monsters are strong, and it's hot, so they're pretty bad.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これがジオ・ゲヘナ……
魔物は強いし、
暑いしで散々だわ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: My throat is dry, and I'm completely drenched in sweat...
text_block_list.orig_text:
喉も渇くし、
すっかり汗だくだにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's have a drink... No, it makes me want to take a bath.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね、
一杯いき……
いえ、
一風呂浴びたくなるわね。

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: Yukari-san... No, more importantly, can you hear something? Is this... an earthshaking?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユカリさん……
いえ、
それよりも何か聞こえません？
これは……
地響き？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Wow, it's soaking wet... Hm? This water's soggy... Could this be...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ、
ビショビショだにゃ……
ん？　
この水、
しゅわしゅわしてるにゃ……
これって、
もしかして？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Yes! This must be the spring that's spouting wheat! It came out of the ground from the impact of the battle!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ！
きっとこれが、
麦しゅわが湧き出る泉なのよ！
戦いの衝撃で、
地下から湧いて出たんだわ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: The invigorating feeling of the squishy skin feels so good. It's like taking a bath, so it's a nice refresher.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しゅわしゅわの爽快感が気持ちいいですわ。
水浴びみたいで、
いいリフレッシュになりましてよ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: It's so breezy, and there's no need to change... How efficient! Maybe I was lucky to be in a swimsuit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっぱりできて、
着替える必要もないなんて……
効率的ね！
水着でラッキーだったのかも。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: That's right! Since we're wearing swimsuits, it'd be a waste not to play with them! Let's eat, nya!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだにゃ！
せっかく水着なんだし、
遊ばないと損にゃ！
えいっ、
くらうにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: Eek! You did it, Tamaki! Here's your payback!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃあ！
やりましたわね、
タマキさん！
お返しですわ、
えいっ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Bwah...! Akino, you're even on me! Eigh! Eey!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぶわっ……！
アキノさん、
私にまでかかってるわよ！
えいっ！　
えいっ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Hehe, everyone looks like they're having fun. But it's true, since we're wearing swimsuits, it'd be a waste if we didn't play. Actually, this is the Fountain of Mugishuwa, so there's no point if we don't drink it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
みんな楽しそう。
でもたしかに、
せっかく水着なんだから、
遊ばないと損よね。
ってゆーか、
麦しゅわの泉なんだから、
飲まなきゃ損よね！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.orig_text:
とゆーわけで、
いただきま～す！
ゴク、
ゴク…………

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Ahh, Yukari-san, you're drinking so much again... Oh? But come to think of it, this smell...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ、
ユカリさんまたそんなに飲んで……
……あら？
でも、
そういえばこの匂いって……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: ...Hey?! This isn't just carbonated water! Why?! It's not enough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちょっとぉ！？　
これただの炭酸水じゃない！
どうしてなのよ！
これじゃ物足りないわ～っ！！
